symbolDescription:
A plugin.

Every built-in feature is one of these, which is what makes `enableX` props,
presets and third-party extensions the same mechanism.

optionDescriptions.name: Unique id. Duplicate names are de-duplicated, last registration winning.
optionDescriptions.dependsOn: Names of plugins that must be set up first.
optionDescriptions.provides: Feature ids this plugin adds to the active schema. Defaults to `[name]`.
optionDescriptions.setup: Runs once on mount; anything it returns is called on teardown.
optionDescriptions.commands: Command handlers, added to the chains of the ids they name.
optionDescriptions.nodes: Custom node types this plugin introduces.
optionDescriptions.marks: Custom inline marks this plugin introduces.
optionDescriptions.keymap: `'Mod+B'` style bindings. A string value is a command id.
optionDescriptions.toolbar: Controls this plugin contributes to the toolbar.
optionDescriptions.slashItems: Entries this plugin contributes to the slash palette.
optionDescriptions.serialize: Serializer rules, in both directions, so the markup round-trips.
optionDescriptions.sanitize: Sanitizer additions, so the markup survives input.
optionDescriptions.ui: Rendered inside the editor root; the home of popovers and menus.
optionDescriptions.priority: Higher runs its command handlers later, so it wins.
